envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: after judge-recovery a fresh session went dark on its first calls: the judge answers, but a judgement on the 29 KB rubric takes 17 to 19 s against a 22 s deadline under omp's 30 s handler kill, so a healthy judge is reported as absent
envelope.cause: operator approved a plan to make the judge fast enough

payload.gloss: a guard binds exactly the agents whose composition includes it, on every supported harness, and judges every turn it fires on; where its judge cannot run, it lets the turn through and says so, never silently, and it asks the judge again once the judge may have recovered, so a passing outage never leaves the guard unjudged for the rest of a session. A judgement fits within the time its harness allows a guard, so a judge that is merely slow is never reported as one that could not run. Where a harness cannot tell which agent is running, the guard is carried as a stated rule instead and the operator is told; a guard that fires and judges nothing never ships.
